title: Points or Rate: Which Costs More on a Six Month Flip
description: One point equals about one month of interest. Here is the formula, a worked $200K example, and the rehab holdback term that costs more than either one.

title: Why DSCR Lenders Require an LLC, and How to Set Yours Up First
description: Why a DSCR loan has to go to an entity, what the LLC does not protect you from, and the eight step setup that keeps entity paperwork from delaying a closing.

title: Hard Money or Conventional? How to Decide on an Investment Property
description: Conventional wins on rate, hard money wins on speed and condition. A decision framework with the actual cost math on a six month flip, plus where DSCR fits.

title: How to Calculate DSCR on a Rental, and What Ratio a Lender Actually Wants
description: DSCR is rent divided by PITIA, but the details decide your deal. How lenders calculate it, what ratio you need, and how to fix a deal that comes in under.

title: What Is Transactional Funding?
description: Transactional funding is 24-hour capital for the A-B leg of a double close. Learn why wholesalers use it, when it makes sense, and exactly how the funding works.

title: What Is a Hard Money Loan?
description: The asset-based, close-in-days loan built for investors, not W-2 borrowers. How it works and what it costs.

title: Why Hard Money Helps Investors Scale
description: Leverage and speed turn one deal a year into several. The math behind doing more with the same cash.

title: Hard Money + DSCR for BRRRR
description: Two loans, one repeatable engine: buy and rehab with hard money, refinance with DSCR, recycle your capital.
